Cockroach is located in the middle-right lower part of the diagram, and Mongoose is located in the upper middle position. In the diagram there is a blue arrow pointing from the Mongoose direction to Cockroach. Reasoning: According to the arrow convention of this diagram, an arrow indicates an organism pointing to the food source it eats. Therefore, the arrow from Mongoose to Cockroach indicates that mongoose eats cockroach.
